title: Q-SAYDO-year-unattended-year: says unattended-year, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe year:unattended-year
**Status:** closed

The system states `unattended-year` (year) and its code does not do it: simulated horizon p10 352 days against 365

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe year:unattended-year` exits 0.

**Evidence:** say-do check at 2026-11-21T11:09:16Z: the statement matches its code or is no longer stated.
